paragraphs.text: The Avacyn Restored set features five bicolored intro packs , each designed to introduce new players to the mechanics, strategies, and flavor of the set while providing a ready-to-play deck. These decks combine straightforward gameplay with thematic synergies, allowing players to experience the set’s signature mechanics such as Angel tribal strategies, soulbond , aggressive Human-centered play, and the undying ability. Each intro pack emphasizes a distinct color pair and strategy, from controlling the battlefield with Angels to pairing creatures for maximum effect, overwhelming opponents with aggressive swarms, or leveraging creature deaths for advantage. While intended as starter decks, the cards included also offer a strong foundation for deck customization, enabling players to expand their collections and explore more advanced interactions within the Avacyn Restored set.
Angelic Might is a green / white intro pack that focuses on Angels .
The rares in this deck are Herald of War (holographic foil) and Angel of Glory's Rise .
Bound by Strength is a green / blue intro pack focused on the soulbond mechanic.
The rares in this deck are Wolfir Silverheart (holographic foil) and Deadeye Navigator .
Fiery Dawn is a red / white intro pack with a focus on cheap creatures and an aggressive strategy .
The rares in this deck are Zealous Conscripts (holographic foil) and Cathars' Crusade .
Slaughterhouse is a black / red intro pack focused on killing creatures and the undying mechanic, and with an aggressive strategy.
The rares in this deck are Harvester of Souls (holographic foil) and Demonlord of Ashmouth .
Solitary Fiends is a blue / black intro pack focused on the " loners " theme.
The rares in this deck are Lone Revenant (holographic foil) and Demonic Rising .
